words.name: Your leaders
words.blurb: Commands and budgets: your Leader and Steward play turns for you.
words.opening: You don't have to order every army yourself. Your Leader takes commands, your Steward builds, and each spends from a purse you fill with a budget. Fairmark lies empty next door.
words.goal: Give your Leader a command and a budget, then let your leaders take all of Fairmark by turn 5.
hints: Open the Leaders panel, tap Command, pick Expand our empire in this direction, and tap Nettlemoor. It plans its own attacks.
Your council asks when something needs you: a purse that's empty is one. Answer it, or set a budget in the Leaders panel.
A budget is a share of your income paid into a leader's purse each turn. Leaders recruit and build only from their purse.
words.closing: Leaders take the routine off your hands, so a deep turn can still be a quick one. That's the last lesson: the bots are waiting.
